The official Binance SOL Staking REST API exposes signed GET account quota BNSOL rate-history reward and operation-history endpoints; the quota response includes redeemPeriod commissionFee stakeable redeemable and soldOut fields.
Both designated ephemeral Binance credential variables were absent, so no signed request was made and no current conversion value eligibility fee capacity or edge was observed.

observed_facts: The official Taker Rebate Program gives weighted volume only to taker trades and defines weighted volume from trade size entry price category weight and bonuses.
Tier rebates apply only after the tier is reached and are not backfilled; level-up bonuses are one-time and every rate threshold weight and bonus is discretionary.
The official fee help says takers can earn a portion of fees back and defines the fee curve, while exact minimum order size tick size and fee parameters remain market-specific.
The program explicitly reserves adjustment or removal for wash trading self-matching or other inauthentic trading.
The current official page documents configured August reward caps for BTC ETH and SOL 5-minute 15-minute and 4-hour TWAP markets.
Actual payout is relative to other makers and random minute samples and the configured pool is only a cap.
The protected boundary is later than nearly the entire documented August allocation window, so a rushed post-boundary activation could not establish representative persistence.
Existing repository work already proved that public reward settings can disagree and that displayed paired quotes omit queue orphan-fill adverse-selection and realized-payout evidence.
